notes:
## New features

- Control whether each building or barrier reflects sound independently of its screening role. Choose generic ISO façade absorption, specified reflection loss, custom values or existing octave-band inputs; the inspector shows the equivalent loss.

## Changes

- New ISO projects enable environmental reflections at order 2. New buildings screen sound but start with reflection disabled. Existing projects retain their saved orders, reflector roles and effective absorption.
- New contour setups use 8× presentation detail. Raw, 2×, 4×, 8× and 16× remain available; interpolation and SmartSmooth reuse calculated values without rerunning propagation.
- Calculate records bounded additional exact support near sources, obstacles and under-resolved regions. Presentation density remains separate from acoustic grid spacing. Resource limits are retained in metadata and shown in the interpolation summary; reaching a limit is not a convergence pass.
- Use coordinated indigo calculation/progress controls and distinct project-saving colours. The compact cancel control has one fixed target and an eased hover enlargement.
- Export an appendix-ready AURIS validation statement with version identity, required/actual deviations and explicit reference qualifications. This is developer-issued evidence, not third-party certification.
- The original T19 reference remains failed and explicitly qualified: published 2024 reflector-size equations admit its 250 Hz reflection, which the 1996-based reference omits. The original oracle is unchanged. Focused analytical and numerical checks are not unrestricted ISO conformance or independent software certification.

- Release verification includes 399 package/source checks and a native packaged calculation, contour, save/reopen and export smoke test. The current frozen regression run completed 1,495 tests without failures before being stopped; full-suite completion and final cold-calculation timing for large reflection-heavy scenes are deferred. No unrestricted conformance claim is made.

## Bug fixes

- Correct finite reflection geometry for rays above low obstacles and façades containing harmless collinear vertices. Use the physical façade dimensions for wavelength eligibility.
- Repair near-collinear constrained triangulations and preserve separate support across verified acoustic transitions, without a silent whole-field linear fallback.
- Correct finite-reflector boundary intersections and support in narrow regions, reducing artificial contour serrations and interpolation errors beside obstacles.
- Retain valid bounded Bézier curves when a whole-edge check previously reverted an entire contour to straight geometry. Corresponding band edges remain shared.
- Reuse transported numerical fields, unchanged local meshes and sampled grids; prepare only the requested SmartSmooth style.
- Keep one operation progress value through calculation, result installation and pending presentation work. Preserve the previous valid view on cancellation.
- Decode calculated numerical results off the GUI thread. Keep delayed cancellation timers attached to their original job so they cannot stop an immediate restart.
- Trim redundant decimal zeros in inspector and global-settings inputs while preserving their configured precision and stored values. Progress-bar cancel icons use the active bar colour and invert contrast over the fill.
- Resolve Save, Don't Save and Cancel once before update restart. Cancelled or failed saves abort the update; an authorised close does not prompt again.
